description:
Reconciliation summary banner.

Optional ``from``/``to`` scope the **per-entry bank-entry counts** (total /
matched / missing-invoice / …) to a ``booking_date`` window — mirroring the
``/bank-entries`` grid filter — so the banner agrees with a month-filtered table.
The cross-month coverage (``bank_accounts`` gaps / ``missing_periods``) stays
**global**: gap detection spans statements regardless of the selected month.
name: reconciliation_summary
